member.summary: Adapter that wraps to implement for backward compatibility.

remarks.para: This adapter enables transparent migration from the old DocxFieldExtractor to the new adaptive extraction system without breaking existing consumer code. It implements the classic **Adapter Pattern**.

Adapter delegates to new with all 5 strategies
